thread:
deploy-bot: Staged rollout started: deployment/redwood-api v2.3.4 - canary 5% -> targets: us-east-1a,us-east-1b. Triggered by: CI pipeline #4821

elena: Seeing a sudden 502/504 spike in hosted inference gateway — starts ~1710101008. Errors on /v1/generate. Dash: https://dash.internal/redwood/alerts/INC-4821 :eyes:

sam: Confirmed — 5xx% up to ~12% on canary nodes, p95 latency increased from 120ms -> 730ms.

nora: Any config flips in this deploy? Deploy-bot shows feature flags changed: `enable-prefetch-v2=true` (intended for canary) — but config payload shows `scope: global` for that flag in the rollout payload.

raj: Gateway logs show repeated upstream timeouts and cache misses. Snippet: 
```
[2026-03-17T12:02:34Z] gateway.go:413 err=\"upstream timeout\" route=\"/v1/generate\" host=\"model-host-3\" code=504
[2026-03-17T12:02:35Z] kvcache.go:88 warn=\"cache exhausted\" alloc=0
```

elena: Quick repro against canary host: 
```
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer xxxxx\" \\\"https://api-canary.redwood.ai/v1/generate\\\" -d '{"prompt":"test","max_tokens":8}'
# result: 504 after ~2s
```

sam: Root cause hypothesis: flag evaluation service returned malformed scope (env var missing in deploy job) so SDK defaulted to enabling prefetch for all traffic. Prefetch path triggers extra upstream model warmups and KV cache pressure, pushing latency/timeouts under canary load.

elena: Paging oncall -> @oncall for rollback? :rotating_light:

oncall-bot: @oncall assigned: raj (incident rotation)

raj: I'll roll back the flag and pull canary traffic. Plan: 1) roll back `enable-prefetch-v2` -> false in LaunchDarkly; 2) scale canary weight -> 0%; 3) monitor 5xx / p95 / kvcache metrics. Exec now.

sam: I'm on it — rolling back flag now.

deploy-bot: Flag `enable-prefetch-v2` set to false by sam at 1710101105

sam: Scaled canary weight to 0 at 1710101110 (api-router update applied).

nora: Metrics: edge 5xx down from 12% -> 1.3% within 30s of rollback. KV cache exhaustion events dropped. p95 back to ~150ms.

support-alex: Customer impact: ~42 support tickets opened in last 10m referencing 5xx on /v1/generate. Triaging top 5 paying tenants now, will send status and offer credit.

elena: Post-incident actions (short list):
- Enforce explicit flag scoping in deploy checks (CI validation fails if scope missing)
- Add a lightweight canary smoke test that issues a small generate call exercising prefetch path
- Improve SDK behavior: default to off if scope eval fails and emit a metric
- Add guard: fail-fast on KV cache exhaustion to avoid cascading timeouts
- Update runbook: include rapid-rollback checklist for flag flips and canary scale commands

raj: Creating incident ticket INC-4821 with owners for each action and ETA. I'll own the SDK hotfix.

support-alex: Posting a status page update now. Notifying affected tenants via email template.

nora: Thanks team — closing operational loop. We should keep this pinned to ensure follow-ups. :thumbsup:
